messages.english: Keep newer crop plans safe when an older app session saves its copy.
messages.translation: Weka mipango mipya zaidi ya mazao salama wakati kipindi cha awali cha programu kinapohifadhi nakala yake.

messages.english: Review retained copies before continuing with your current crop plan.
messages.translation: Pitia nakala zilizohifadhiwa kabla ya kuendelea na mpango wako wa sasa wa mazao.

messages.english: Retry interrupted guest crop transfers without replacing saved account work.
messages.translation: Jaribu tena uhamishaji uliokatizwa wa kazi ya mazao ya mgeni bila kubadilisha kazi iliyohifadhiwa kwenye akaunti.
Pitia hifadhi ya mpango wa mazao
Mpango wa uzalishaji → Hifadhi ya mpango wa mazao

messages.english: Check the storage notice. If an older session changed its copy, download both copies and review them before choosing to keep your current plan.
messages.translation: Angalia ilani ya hifadhi. Ikiwa kipindi cha awali kilibadilisha nakala yake, pakua nakala zote mbili na uzipitie kabla ya kuchagua kubakiza mpango wako wa sasa.
